name: tenants_pay_bands
description: List the active tenant's pay bands in order, position 1 first. Of the bands that match a seat, the last in the list has the last word. Each band gives its position, its matcher (the role family, role, level number and location it matches on; one left out matches anything), its currency, period (year, month or hour) and minimum, midpoint and maximum as decimal strings, as entered and never converted. shadowed is true for a band that can never have the last word, as a later band matches every seat it does. in_framework is false for a band whose level, role or role family has left the framework. Give pay_band_id to read one band. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
